findings.summary: PR reads as AI-generated; Pallets closes those on sight
Adds os.PathLike as a new serialized type with no ticket; apps can handle it via default override, and bundled with an unrelated change
Dataclass class guard fixes no bug and makes the error message worse; invalid input is fixed, not caught
str(o) is the wrong conversion for os.PathLike; os.fspath should be used
PR body makes false claims (matches stdlib behavior, tests pass with no output) and docstring/CHANGES not updated
Imports inside test functions instead of at top of file

why: Finding 2 says which types the provider serializes is a design call and not wanted, and finding 3 says the dataclass error change fixes nothing, matching the maintainer's reasons; finding 1 covers the AI policy.
